{{Quote|Serroco was scoured by nuclear fire, and Neo-Crusaders ravaged Nouane, whose elegant civilization and ancient mastery of statecraft epitomized all they despised.|From Vilnau Teupt's "Industry, Honor, Savagery: Shaping the Mandalorian Soul", 24 ABY|<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
A '''battle''' was fought during the [[Mandalorian Wars]] on [[Nouane/Legends|Nouane]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the eponymous mini-[[Empire (disambiguation)|empire]] [[Nouane (Allied Region)|Nouane]]. In [[3963 BBY]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] launched a [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] assault from [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalorian space]] into the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. After [[Battle of Serroco|taking]] the planet [[Serroco]], the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] proceeded along their invasion corridor to Nouane and conquered the world; as a result, representatives of the beleaguered planet turned to the Republic for assistance. After taking Nouane, the Mandalorians proceeded to a [[Battle of Dagary Minor|victory]] at [[Dagary Minor]] before their advance was haulted following a [[First Battle of Omonoth|battle]] on the planet of [[Omonoth]]. Eventually the Mandalorians were driven off the planet of Nouane, and the government joined the Republic as a semi-autonomous [[Allied Region]].<ref name="Atlas" />

In the [[Industry, Honor, Savagery: Shaping the Mandalorian Soul|keynote address]] at the four-hundred-twelfth [[Proceedings of Galactic Anthropology and History]], in [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], [[Vilnau Teupt]] spoke of the Mandalorian race's development, mentioning the capture of Nouane while talking through the Mandalorian Wars.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[Book/Legends|book]] written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] that was released in [[2009]].<ref name="Atlas" />
